data.seoTitle: Binance Will Support the Sei (SEI) Network Migration
data.seoDesc: Starting at approximately 2026-06-01 08:00 (UTC), Binance will suspend the deposits and withdrawals of token(s) on the SEI network to support its network migration to the SEIEVM network.
